POLITICAL FILE NOTICE 
 
WTXF-TV, Philadelphia, PA 
 
On October 5, 2026, at 3:16 PM station staff accidently deleted all files that had been timely 
uploaded and were present in the 2026 political file folder entitled “Bob Brooks for Congress.”  
Station staff took immediate action and, within 15 minutes of deletion, re-uploaded all files that 
were required to be retained in the station’s political file.  
 
Please direct questions to the undersigned.    
 
Sincerely, 
 
/s/ 
 
Evan S. Morris 
Vice President, FCC Legal & Business Affairs 
FOX Corporation 
Evan.Morris@fox.com
